_comment: Host-lane notification intents (2026-10-15; AGENTS.md §23.23 'n8n requests a send through a host intent API, and the host decides delivery', §24.1, §9.1). A HOST lane fired from the n8n fabric may not call a sender (allowlist never-list), so it queues its operator notification as a comms intent in the coordination ledger's comms_intents table through scripts/lib/host_comms_intents.py; the host comms-intent consumer (scripts/n8n_comms_intent_consumer.py) turns it into an incident and the incident notifier sends it (DIGEST -> P2). Each row names the ONE producer allowed to queue that (domain, kind). Kept OUT of config/n8n_comms_intent_routes.json on purpose: (1) n8n's comms/intent route reads only that file, so n8n can never post a host-lane intent (it cannot impersonate a producer), and (2) that file's sha256 is part of the fabric policy hash, so a host route never moves the imported fabric workflows' policy. Dedupe window and hourly cap are the n8n table's (one shared budget). Changed only by reviewed PR. No PAGE row: a P1 never depends on this path.
_comment_20261022_desk_truth: 2026-10-22 (operator: "fix all of these n8n first for scheduling and monitoring"): scripts/desk_truth_monitor.py (lanes holdings-drift-monitor, options-desk-staleness-monitor, held-exit-coverage-monitor) queues ONE intent per run only when that check's alertable finding set GAINED a finding (state data/runtime/<lane>_alert_state.json, on top of the store dedupe); all DIGEST -> P2, never a sender (the #1899 direct intent-store pattern, through check_registry_runtime_truth.queue_host_intent). Runbook docs/ops/DESK_TRUTH_MONITORS.md.
_comment_20261018: 2026-10-18 (data-integrity fix PR, operator: the two data monitors 'within n8n with proper contracts'): lanes n8n-data-plausibility-audit and n8n-gap-resolution-audit run with --notify queue once their allowlist live_arg carries it, so they may not call a sender. data/data_plausibility_violation and data/gap_resolution_finding (RETIRED_RAN, VECTOR_FAILING) are DIGEST -> P2 incidents; data/gap_resolution_digest (OPEN_NO_ATTEMPT, REFUSED_NOWHERE) is DASHBOARD -> P3, never an interrupt. The systemd units keep the chokepoint send (--notify send, the default) until the packet's c3 step.
_comment_20261021: 2026-10-21 (PR #1899, n8n shadow lane hermes-watchlist-scorer): the scorer's loud-failure alert (OUTAGE: nothing landed; DEGRADED: >20% of names errored) is queued as research/hermes_watchlist_scorer_failure (DIGEST -> P2) instead of a send_telegram call, because a dispatched lane may not send (tests/test_agents_policy_7_0_0_advisory_market_data.py). The scorer keeps its own 12h per-condition cooldown (data/runtime/hermes_watchlist_scorer_alert_state.json) on top of the store dedupe.
_comment_20261021_pr_hygiene: 2026-10-21 (operator process plan: PR hygiene audited every iteration and alerted back): the n8n shadow lane pr-hygiene-audit (scripts/pr_hygiene_audit.py) queues agents/pr_hygiene_findings only when its alertable finding set GAINED a finding (state data/runtime/pr_hygiene_audit_alert_state.json, on top of the store dedupe) and agents/pr_hygiene_weekly_digest once per ISO week; both DIGEST -> P2, never a sender (the #1899 direct intent-store pattern).
